o21.F5c.judge_why: The crop (f0c3fbd77b159e3d.jpg) is a raw Nyquist plot (-Z'' vs Z') with four cycle-labeled series (3rd, 60th, 150th, 250th) plus an equivalent-circuit inset; visually the dashed lines fan out such that the 3rd-cycle (red) curve sits farthest right (highest Z') and the 250th-cycle (gray) curve sits farthest left (lowest Z') at a given -Z'', i.e. the steep lines shift to lower Z' as cycling proceeds, and no distinct growing semicircle is visible at this axis scale -- exactly matching node o21. The second reader correctly identified the plot type, axes, legend, and equivalent circuit but misread the trend direction (describing it as increasing impedance with cycling rather than decreasing Z'); that is a reader misinterpretation of the same panel, not a mismatch between the node and the crop, so the grader's contradiction flag is not a real citation error.
